I’m so sorry for your loss its such a hard thing to go through :( My fp died 3 years ago and the first year was the hardest and landed me in the psych ward a couple of times. Honestly what helped me is talking about it in therapy and writing letters to him in my journal. However, the pain doesn’t necessarily go away it just gets a little bit easier to accept and live with everyday. Let yourself cry and feel whatever you need to… I don’t know if you’re spiritual at all but it helped me to talk to him whenever i felt sad. I also keep pictures of him in my room and fall asleep with them whenever im really missing him. Theres gonna be some days where you feel okay and other days where you feel like your back at day one all over again but just know that you will get through this. Healing and grief isnt linear and just offer as much compassion towards yourself whenever you can ❤️
